description.en: Creates a detailed (Hi) model of the story character para_cpNNNN in the given kit: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(4, _charaName, set, _face, _body, true, _home, _keeper, shoes, gloves, false, _no_base, _mem, _uniform_no), with set "Talk" when _talk is true ("dmy" otherwise), shoes = _body and gloves = _body for a goalkeeper.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
Character number: the model is para_cpNNNN (the developers named this argument _face).
Body (kit) number; also used as the shoes number, and as the gloves number for a goalkeeper.
true for the home kit, false for away.
true for the goalkeeper outfit (gloves get the body number).
true for the "Talk" motion set (talking model), false for "dmy".
Passed as CMND_CREATE_CHARA's noBase flag (effect not traced).
Uniform number passed as CMND_CREATE_CHARA's uniform value.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: A detailed model for a close-up (real usage, from ev42011200.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
examples.code: local hShindouH = CreateEvHiMdlForNumber(charaName, 9, 1, true, false, false);
